summary: Learn QGIS mapping, WASH data preparation and service coverage analysis. Explore the five-day course and build practical map-based outputs.
lede: GIS mapping and spatial analysis for WASH programmes helps WASH officers, field coordinators and programme analysts turn service data into location-based evidence. The foundation-level course covers preparing water-point and settlement layers, checking GPS records and coordinate systems, joining indicators to boundaries, assessing proximity and service coverage, and creating maps and action briefs that communicate data limits.
audienceIntro: This foundation-level course suits professionals who handle WASH service data, field locations or programme maps and need to turn them into useful spatial evidence. It is designed for roles that connect field operations with planning and reporting.
audience: WASH Programme Managers using spatial evidence
modules: GPS, CRS and WASH Data Quality
QGIS WASH Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with WASH service delivery or programme data is useful. No prior GIS experience or programming is required.
topics: Water & wastewater treatment and utility management
